notes: Tier III+ certified carrier-independent colocation data center in Osmangazi district, Bursa (Ovaakca Egitim Mah., Istanbul Cad No:750/A). Operator site and datacenters.com list it as Tier III standard; Bursa press reports the ~1,600 sqm facility runs on solar power (GES first phase 259.65 kW) with UPS/generators and 3-city/4-city backup replication. No public MW capacity published.
